title: Include visual reference images for key characters (e.g., the enemy) to prevent…
content: Include visual reference images for key characters (e.g., the enemy) to prevent the model from misidentifying roles and generating incorrect interactions (like attacking allies/self).
tips: Include visual reference images for key characters (e.g., the enemy) to prevent the model from misidentifying roles and generating incorrect interactions (like attacking allies/self).

es.content:
Incluye imágenes de referencia visual para los personajes clave (por ejemplo, el enemigo) para evitar que el modelo identifique erróneamente los roles y genere interacciones incorrectas (como atacar a aliados o a uno mismo).
